speaker: Doctor
text: I see you are experiencing fatigue, abdominal pain, night sweats, and weight loss, along with an enlarged supraclavicular lymph node. To help narrow down the cause, how long have you had these symptoms, and have you noticed any changes in your bowel habits or appetite?

speaker: Patient
text: The fatigue, abdominal pain, night sweats, and weight loss have been bothering me for about four weeks, while the neck swelling just appeared four days ago. speaker: Doctor
text: Given the rapid onset of systemic symptoms and the new supraclavicular lymphadenopathy, I must rule out malignancy immediately. DIAGNOSIS READY: Lymphoma
